data.narrative:
Nimble Robotics, a Series C robotics and manufacturing company, is evaluated against a comparable universe of 9 private peers and 1 public peer (277810.KQ). The private peer set includes same-sector, same- and adjacent-stage companies: Hadrian ($1.6B, Series C), Exotec ($2.0B, Series D), Bedrock Robotics ($1.8B, Series B), Dexterity ($1.6B, Series B), and Generalist AI ($2.0B, Series B), among others.

Two triangulation methods prove applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.7x step-up multiplier to the company's last post-money valuation of $1.0B, implying $1.7B. Peer-median analysis across the 6 most directly comparable robotics peers (same sector, overlapping stage bands) yields a median valuation of $1.7B, with a range of $1.0B to $2.0B. Both methods converge on identical implied values, strengthening confidence in the result.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $1.4B to $2.0B, with a median of $1.7B. This median aligns with both the stage-progression step-up and peer-group positioning. Key uncertainties include unit economics validation, near-term revenue trajectory, and the broader robotics funding environment, which currently shows variance across the peer set of $400M between min and max comparables.
